description.zh: 需要修改用户信息的互动消息应用ID。
description.en: The ID of the interactive messaging application whose user information you want to modify.

description.zh: 数据中心，需要与[CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~)中的数据中心一致，当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai）、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）。
description.en: The data center. It must be the same as the data center that was specified when you called the [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2593195~~) operation to create the interactive messaging application. Valid values: cn-shanghai and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore).
The ID of the user whose information you want to modify.

description.zh: 修改后的用户扩展信息，长度不超过512字节。
description.en: The additional information about the user after the modification. The value can be up to 512 bytes in length.

descriptions.zh: 本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en: 本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live modify-live-message-user-info --app-id demo --user-id uid2 --user-meta-info uid2meta2 --data-center cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live ModifyLiveMessageUserInfo --region cn-hangzhou --DataCenter 'cn-shanghai' --AppId demo --UserId uid2 --UserMetaInfo uid2meta2
